'''Ratamesh''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="PotJS" /> located in the [[Ratamesh system/Legends|Ratamesh system]], a part of the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> It was the site of the [[Thisspias alcazar]], a structure which shared its name with<ref name="PotJS" /> the Farstey [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Thisspias">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Thisspias system/Legends|Thisspias system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]].<ref name="PotJS" />

In [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] was 174 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] and that he was twenty when [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|his sister]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Ratamesh. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the events on Ratamesh must have occurred in [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]].</ref> the [[Monarchy/Legends|reigning]] [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] of Thisspias, the [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|sister]] of the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], was present at the Thisspias alcazar on Ratamesh. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], agitators [[Storming of the Thisspias alcazar|stormed]] the alcazar and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Blood Monarch. As a result, the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of Thisspias was inherited by Rancisis, although he abdicated in favor of continuing his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]].<ref name="PotJS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ratamesh was introduced in the reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and published on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<<ref name="NEGTCDate">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/news20020212.html|text=Book Preview: The New Essential Guide}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ratamesh [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Ratamesh itself, in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

In ''The New Essential Guide to Characters'', the preposition "in" is used in conjunction with the proper name "Ratamesh" when providing context for the Thisspias alcazar, suggesting that they were both locations on Thisspias.<ref name="NEGTC" /> In the ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'', a [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook<ref name="PotJS" /> published in [[August]] 2002<ref name="Amazon">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020815cpreview&c=rpg|text=Take a Look Inside: A Preview of the ''Power of the Jedi Sourcebook''}}</ref> for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', most of the wording regarding Ratamesh from ''The New Essential Guide to Characters'' is kept, except the preposition "on" is used, suggesting instead that it was an astronomical object separate from Thisspias. This article assumes the latter source is correct.<ref name="PotJS" />
